name: Surf and Turf
body:
Station and Complexity boucher 3, poissonier 5

Flavor Profiles umami, umami, temperature
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, spicy, sour, sweet, texture, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 10 minutes, or 1 round/level when consumed; Serving Size 1d4

DESCRIPTION

When consumed, it grants an additional talent (including discoveries, rage powers, and similar class options) or an extra resource feat (such as Extra Rage) as a bonus feat for 1 round/level, chosen by the consumer. Extra resources gained in this way are used first and don’t count against the consumer’s total resources.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each.
